name: Engineo
author: justnaveenthings

sections.description:
Engineo is the ultimate all-engine optimization plugin that goes beyond traditional SEO to optimize your WordPress site for search engines, local search, and AI engines. Built with modern WordPress standards and full Elementor compatibility.

Key Features

SEO Optimization:
* Meta title & description editor for posts, pages, and Elementor pages
* XML sitemap generator with customizable settings
* Robots.txt editor with existing file detection
* Canonical URL management
* Basic schema markup support (Article, BlogPosting, Product, FAQ, HowTo)
* LocalBusiness schema for single-location businesses
* OpenGraph and Twitter Card support

AI Engine Optimization (AEO):
* llms.txt generator/editor – unique feature for AI engines
* AI-ready content structure
* Rich snippet preview for AI engines

Advanced Features:
* 301/302 redirect manager
* SEO health check with scoring system
* FAQ & HowTo schema auto-generator
* Basic local keyword suggestions
* Import settings from Yoast SEO and Rank Math

Elementor Integration:
* Full Elementor compatibility
* Meta data extraction from Elementor widgets
* No conflicts with Elementor’s DOM or scripts
* Support for both Elementor Free and Pro

Why Choose Engineo?

  • All-Engine Optimization: Optimize for search engines, local search, and AI engines
  • Elementor Native: Built specifically for Elementor users
  • Modern Standards: Uses WordPress 6.x+ and PHP 8+ features
  • Clean Interface: Simpler and cleaner than Yoast or Rank Math
  • Unique Features: llms.txt for AI engines, comprehensive health scoring
  • Performance Focused: Lightweight and fast

Technical Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
  • Elementor (recommended for full functionality)

Support

For support, feature requests, and bug reports, please visit our support forum or contact us through our website.

Privacy Policy

Engineo does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All optimization data remains on your WordPress installation.

Credits

Built by the Engineo team with modern WordPress development practices and a focus on performance and user experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/engineo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Engineo menu in your WordPress admin to configure the plugin
  4. Start optimizing your content for all engines!
sections.faq:
What makes Engineo different from other SEO plugins?

Engineo is the first plugin to offer “all-engine optimization” – optimizing for search engines, local search, and AI engines. It includes unique features like llms.txt for AI engines and is built specifically with Elementor compatibility in mind.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is a unique file that provides information about your website for AI engines and language models. It’s similar to robots.txt but specifically designed for AI training and understanding.

What is the SEO Health Check?

The SEO Health Check analyzes your site and provides a score based on how well your content meets SEO best practices. It checks for missing meta titles, descriptions, and other optimization factors.

Is Engineo compatible with WordPress multisite?

Yes, Engineo works with both single-site and multisite WordPress installations.
